description: Defines stack operations and utilities for the ATen core library in PyTorch, including stack manipulation, operation registration, and function packing.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents a stack operation with registration and invocation capabilities.

classes.name: TuplePacker
classes.description: Template struct for packing tuple elements onto the stack.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns a reference to the element at position i from the top of the stack.

methods.name: peekSlice
methods.description: Returns a slice of the last N elements starting at index i.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last N elements as a slice.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Removes n elements from the top of the stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top element or top N elements from the stack.

methods.name: pop (variadic)
methods.description: Pops multiple elements and assigns them to provided variables.

methods.name: push_one
methods.description: Pushes a single element onto the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes multiple elements onto the stack.

methods.name: push_list_elements
methods.description: Pushes elements of a list onto the stack.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Pushes a value or tuple of values onto the stack.
